title: arrhenatherum avenaceum var. precatorium
intro: Arrhenatherum avenaceum var. precatorium, commonly known as Sweet Woodruff, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its white flowers and sweet, grassy aroma. The health benefits of Sweet Woodruff include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic and anti-diarrheal agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its sedative and calming properties. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Woodruff include coumarins, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
